reason: A declarative policy utility for DeepSeek Harness that evaluates tool-call and subprocess network rules, supports allow/deny/ask outcomes, and records audit events.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 YAML 的工具调用与子进程网络权限规则、审批决策、审计记录和热加载能力。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with YAML-based tool-call and subprocess network rules, allow/deny/ask decisions, audit logging, and hot reload.

capabilities: Declarative allow, deny, and ask decisions for tool calls
Rule matching on tool names, arguments, agents, workspace paths, environment conditions, and network targets
Audit logging of permission decisions and blocked network connections
Hot reload and dry-run evaluation of YAML rule files
Local HTTP/CONNECT proxy for shell subprocess network traffic
Settings page and /rules command for policy inspection and testing
